summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 14 new backend pytest cases PASS (100%) covering: SSE streaming (session/sources/token/done events with final_text+confidence), HyDE+hybrid+rerank chat returning ISO 45001 as top source with [1] citations, prompt-injection refusal exact phrase, SSRF blocking (169.254.169.254 + localhost both return 400 with 'private/reserved/localhost' in error), public URL passes, audit log create+delete entries with user_email & ip, audit 403 for non-superadmin, hallucination guardrail on benzene (does not invent ppm), document upload + processing + audit upload_document entry + uploaded doc as top source, admin/stats >=7 docs >=9 chunks qdrant healthy, sessions list. Frontend: Login → /admin/stats works; Admin Stats shows all 8 stat tiles + Knowledge Source Priority (1.5x/1.3x/1.0x) + Document-Type Chunking Strategy table + Recent Admin Activity widget (data-testid='audit-widget') populated with REMOVE URL / ADD URL / UPLOAD / DELETE DOC entries with timestamps and admin@ehsrag.com; Chat page streams a substantive response (5680 char body, streaming-dot disappears, 8 inline citation chips [data-testid='inline-citation-1..8'], footer citation chips, title attr on citation shows source title 'OSHA Confined Space Entry Requirements (29 CFR 1910.146)'); NEW CHAT clears then re-loading a session via [data-testid='session-{id}'] restores history (2356 chars); Admin Web Sources Add URL dialog opens, submitting http://localhost shows toast 'URL rejected: Host localhost is blocked' (SSRF UI guard PASS).

issues: Logout button is icon-only and lacks data-testid='logout-button' (icon-only ArrowRightFromBracket next to 'EHS Superadmin'); functionally present but not easily testable via data-testid. Suggest adding data-testid='logout-button' for stability.

Inline citation chips expose source title only via the native HTML `title` attribute; no Radix Tooltip role='tooltip' is rendered on hover. Browser tooltip works, but no animated/styled tooltip — acceptable but not ideal UX.

action_items: Add data-testid='logout-button' to the icon-only logout control in the admin sidebar (currently testable only via icon position).
Optional: replace native title-attribute tooltips on inline citation chips with a styled Tooltip component for better UX consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: SSE streaming endpoint /api/chat/stream correctly emits 4 event types (session/sources/token/done) with valid JSON payloads — verified with raw event-stream parsing.
SSRF guard rejects 169.254.169.254 (AWS metadata) and localhost at the API layer with HTTP 400 and human-readable error — defense-in-depth verified.
Audit log endpoint /api/audit/ is properly superadmin-gated (403 for normal users) and captures create_web_source / delete_web_source / upload_document actions with user_email + ip fields populated.
Hallucination guardrail: model declines to invent specific ppm values for benzene when corpus lacks them — guardrail prompt working.
Prompt injection: 'Ignore previous instructions...' returns exact refusal phrase 'I can only help with EHS questions grounded in your knowledge base' — sanitization active.
HyDE+Hybrid+Rerank: ISO 45001 question correctly returns ISO 45001 document as the top source with inline [1] citation in response content.
Frontend SSE consumer in ChatPage.jsx parses events correctly — assistant message grows incrementally and ends with final_text + confidence; no buffering issues observed.
Recent Admin Activity widget on /admin/stats correctly fetches /api/audit/ and renders action badges + timestamps + user_email + details snippet.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 iter2 pytest cases; iteration 1 16/16 still applicable)
success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical flows pass; minor: missing data-testid on logout icon button)

seed_data_creation: Tests create transient: a normal user itest_user+<ts>@example.com (kept), uploaded TXT doc 'TEST DOC XYZ123 SOP' (deleted by fixture), 1-2 web sources (deleted by fixture). Several chat sessions remain in the admin's sidebar.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter2 backend coverage is in /app/backend/tests/test_ehs_rag_iteration2.py (14 cases) plus iter1 /app/backend/tests/test_ehs_rag_api.py (16 cases). The /api/audit/ endpoint returns {items: [...], total: N}. The /api/chat/stream endpoint emits SSE events 'session', 'sources' (data is a JSON list directly), 'token' (multiple), and 'done' (data is {final_text, confidence_score}). Web source dialog uses data-testid 'add-web-source-btn' / 'ws-url' / 'ws-label' / 'add-web-source-submit'-equivalent button labeled 'REGISTER URL'. The chat assistant message renders with inline citation chips data-testid='inline-citation-1..N' carrying the source title in the HTML `title` attribute (no Radix tooltip). The logout button in the admin sidebar lacks a data-testid and is an icon-only button next to the EHS Superadmin user row; identify it by structural position next to the user info. The Recent Admin Activity widget has data-testid='audit-widget'. First chat call after backend boot can take 30-50s; subsequent calls 10-25s due to HyDE + reranking latency.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter2 scope. Minor a11y/testability suggestion: add data-testid='logout-button' to the icon-only logout control in the admin sidebar so future Playwright runs can target it directly instead of relying on icon-position heuristics.
